hero.eyebrow: Serving Ohio, Michigan, and Indiana for over 55 years
hero.heading: We supply commercial doors, locks, & security systems
paragraphs: Since 1968, General Building Products has supplied commercial doors, frames, locks, and security hardware to projects across Ohio, Michigan, and Indiana.
Our experienced installers make sure the job is done right, and we ship anywhere in the U.S. and Canada.

servicesIntro.heading: What We Do
servicesIntro.text: More than a parts counter. We prep, deliver, and stand behind every order, from a single closer to a building's worth of openings.

services.title: Installation
services.description: Hardware is installed in our shop before delivery, so doors arrive ready to hang.

services.title: Service Calls & Estimates
services.description: We come to you for on-site estimates, and follow up to make sure everything works right.

services.title: Local Delivery
services.description: No truck big enough? We deliver throughout our local service area.

services.title: Nationwide Shipping
services.description: Outside our delivery area, we ship to all 50 states and Canada.

services.title: Custom Solutions
services.description: Unusual opening or tricky spec? Our team will work out a solution for your project.

servicesCta.heading: Not sure what you need?
servicesCta.text: Call and talk it through with our team.

highlights.heading: Expertise you won't find at a big‑box store

supplyIntro.heading: Every door, and everything on it
supplyIntro.text: Doors, frames, hardware, and security, plus the restroom and building specialties that finish the job. One supplier, one order, one call.

about.heading: Doors, frames & hardware, done right since 1968
paragraphs: General Building Products has been in the commercial door and hardware business since 1968. More than 55 years later, we offer a full line of commercial doors and frames, plus all the hardware that goes with them.
Behind the counter is a team that knows openings inside and out, including a bonded locksmith, an AHC certified consultant, and a complete hollow metal and door fabrication shop.
